analysis.description: This paper discusses the set-up, results, and analysis of the Liver Tumor Segmentation Benchmark (LiTS) across multiple international conferences. It introduces a multi-center dataset, evaluates state-of-the-art liver and liver tumor segmentation algorithms, and provides insights into the challenges and future directions for liver tumor segmentation research.

type.justification: The paper involves analysis of multiple liver tumor segmentation algorithms and presents empirical results from the LiTS challenge events.
